## Spirit Airlines (SAVE) – Operating KPIs Reported for FY 2024

Source: FY2024 Form 10-K (filed March 3, 2025), Item 7 – "Comparative Operating Statistics" for the twelve months ended December 31, 2024 (unaudited).

| Operating KPI | FY 2024 Total | FY 2023 (comparison) |
|---|---|---|
| Average aircraft | 209.9 | 199.5 |
| Aircraft at end of period¹ | 213 | 205 |
| Average daily aircraft utilization (hours) | 9.9 | 11.1 |
| Departures | 288,180 | 297,900 |
| Passenger flight segments (PFSs, thousands) | 44,180 | 44,105 |
| Revenue passenger miles (RPMs, thousands) | 43,671,009 | 45,243,787 |
| Available seat miles (ASMs, thousands) | 53,017,948 | 55,665,561 |
| Load factor (%) | 82.4% | 81.3% |
| Total revenue per passenger flight segment ($) | 111.21 | 121.58 |
| Average yield (cents per RPM) | 11.25 | 11.85 |
| TRASM – total revenue per ASM (cents) | 9.27 | 9.63 |
| CASM – operating expense per ASM (cents) | 11.35 | 10.52 |
| Adjusted CASM (cents)² | 10.76 | 10.33 |
| Adjusted CASM ex‑fuel (cents)² | 7.97 | 7.06 |
| Fuel gallons consumed (thousands) | 551,819 | 591,796 |
| Average fuel cost per gallon ($) | 2.68 | 3.08 |

¹ Includes 21 aircraft recorded as assets held for sale on the December 31, 2024 balance sheet. Fleet composition at year‑end: 2 A319ceo, 63 A320ceo, 91 A320neo, 29 A321ceo, 28 A321neo (average age ~5.8 years).
² Adjusted CASM excludes special items (asset disposal losses/gains, special charges, furlough‑related costs, litigation loss contingency adjustments); Adjusted CASM ex‑fuel additionally excludes aircraft fuel and related taxes.

### Notes on scope
- The 10‑K table above is the company's definitive full‑year KPI set (16 metrics: capacity/traffic, load factor, fleet, utilization, unit revenue, unit cost, and fuel).
- Spirit's interim earnings releases (1Q–3Q24) additionally present **average stage length (miles)** and split total revenue per PFS into **fare revenue per segment** and **non‑ticket revenue per segment**; these two ancillary-split metrics and stage length are *not* carried in the 10‑K's annual operating statistics table (quarterly stage length readings were 995 mi in 1Q24 and 981 mi in 2Q24).
- Key FY 2024 takeaways vs. 2023: capacity (ASMs) −4.8%, traffic (RPMs) −3.5%, load factor +1.1 pts to 82.4%, but unit costs rose (CASM +7.9%; Adjusted CASM ex‑fuel +12.9%) on lower utilization (9.9 hrs, −10.8%) and higher aircraft rent, while fuel price fell 13.0% to $2.68/gal.
